Kitchen and Cooking > 8.5 Cooking Pakistani dishes without setting off the alarm

Frying onions, tempering spices (tadka) and making parathas can create smoke that triggers the smoke detector. Before you start, switch on the exhaust fan and open a window, and use the lowest flame that works. **Never cover or disable the smoke detector.** If the alarm sounds from cooking smoke, fan the detector with a towel and open the balcony door; it stops by itself within a minute. If you see actual flames, use the kitchen fire extinguisher or a damp cloth over the pan, leave the apartment and follow section 12.2."},{"source_id":"20.5","title":"First-time visitors to Pakistan","text":"House manual > 20.
